trap-superlative.notes: Rigor flag (not a trap, reported separately): the neighbouring 'Among all genus-4 curves, Bring's surface is the terminal object ... any other genus-4 QOU maps to it. This establishes the Descartes theorem.' quantifies over CURVES but justifies over QOUs, and in the category of curves with non-constant morphisms it is false by Riemann--Hurwitz (a non-constant map between curves of equal genus is an isomorphism).
